name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 7 visits over 63 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.6 days starting 2025-05-15, at wavelengths from 1.12 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
